accounts.title: Accounts and servers
accounts.empty: No saved accounts. Add a server or sign in to another account below.
accounts.add: Add another account on this server
accounts.logoutWarning: This deletes this device's saved credentials and attempts to revoke that server session. Remote revocation may not be confirmed. Already-issued access tokens can remain usable until expiry.
accounts.removeWarning: This irreversibly forgets only this saved account and its local credentials. The server and other accounts remain. This does not revoke the remote session; log out first if you also want to attempt revocation.
accounts.forgetWarning: All local accounts and credentials for this server will be forgotten. Remote session revocation is not guaranteed.
accounts.logoutConfirmed: {{username}} is signed out locally. The server confirmed revocation of future refresh. Already-issued access tokens may remain usable until expiry.
accounts.logoutUnconfirmed: {{username}} is signed out locally. Remote revocation was not confirmed; the server may still hold a valid session. Already-issued access tokens may remain usable until expiry. No automatic retry will run.
accounts.removed: The saved account {{username}} was removed locally. No remote revocation was requested.

status.signedOut: Signed out — sign in to use

navigation.nativeBackError: System back navigation is unavailable. Use the navigation links.
navigation.label: Main navigation
navigation.notFoundHint: This page is not available. Return to Home.
navigation.error: This page could not be displayed.

auth.usernameHint: 3–32 ASCII letters, digits or underscores. The server canonicalizes case.
auth.passwordHint: At least 8 Unicode code points and at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes. Sent exactly as entered.
auth.registered: Account created. Registration does not sign you in; continue to the sign-in form.
auth.savedServer: Use the saved address below. A previous inspection is not proof of current server identity or availability.
auth.httpWarning: HTTP exposes your password and session tokens in transit. Continue only if you accept this risk.
auth.browserWarning: Browser session tokens are stored unencrypted and can be read by same-origin scripts. Private browsing may discard them.
auth.nativeWarning: Credentials use this device's system-protected adapter. Access may fail if its user key or credential service is unavailable.
auth.open: Self-registration is currently advertised as open.
auth.closed: Self-registration is closed. Existing or administrator-provisioned accounts can still sign in.
auth.legacy: Acknowledged legacy server: registration policy is unconfirmed. The server may reject registration.
auth.policyFailed: Current registration policy could not be confirmed. This does not mean registration is open.
auth.registerLink: Create an account on this server
auth.cancelled: Request cancelled. A submitted server operation may already have completed.
auth.ambiguousRegistration: Registration could not be confirmed. The account may already exist; try signing in before registering again.
auth.retryAfter: The server requested a wait of {{seconds}} seconds before trying again.
auth.passwordPolicy: Use at least 8 Unicode code points and at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes, without unpaired surrogates.

errors.registrationClosed: The server has closed registration. Existing or administrator-provisioned accounts can still sign in.
errors.network: The server could not be reached. Check the connection, CORS and TLS settings, then retry.
errors.timeout: The server did not respond in time. Check the connection and retry.
errors.redirect: The server redirected this request. Authentication was stopped without forwarding credentials.
errors.rate-limited: The server is limiting requests. Wait before trying again.
errors.server: The server could not complete the request. Try again later.
errors.credentials: The username or password is incorrect.
errors.disabled: This user is disabled. Contact the server administrator.
errors.usernameTaken: This username is already taken. Choose another username or sign in.
errors.username: Use 3–32 ASCII letters, digits or underscores for the username.
errors.password: The server rejected the new password. Review the password requirements.
errors.request: The server rejected this authentication request. Check the input and server compatibility.
errors.requestTooLarge: The server rejected the request because it is too large.
errors.session: This session can no longer authenticate or renew. Sign in again.
errors.identity: The session or account identity changed unexpectedly. The saved account was not rebound.
errors.recovery: Renewal or storage was interrupted. The old refresh credential will not be retried. Sign in again.
errors.expired: The session reached its absolute expiration. Sign in again.
errors.missing: No verified credentials are available for this saved account. Retry storage or sign in again.
errors.malformed: The server returned an invalid or incompatible authentication response. Authentication could not be confirmed.
errors.storage: The client could not confirm session storage. Check storage or the credential service and retry; restarting may be necessary.
errors.locked: Unlock the system credential vault and retry. No new session was confirmed as saved.
errors.capacity: This system cannot store this credential envelope. No new session was confirmed as saved.
errors.coordination: Safe session storage requires Web Locks in a supported secure browser context. Use HTTPS, localhost or the native app.
errors.clock: New credentials already appear expired. Check the device time and server session settings.
errors.unknown: Authentication could not be completed. Check the saved server and retry.

localDiscovery.title: Local server suggestions
localDiscovery.none: No compatible local server found. You can still enter an address manually.
localDiscovery.ready: Windwatcher v1 is ready now. Use the address to check it manually; nothing will be saved.
localDiscovery.notReady: Windwatcher is responding but is not ready. Check again later or enter another address.
localDiscovery.unknown: Windwatcher is recognized, but readiness is unknown. Check again or enter the address manually.
localDiscovery.legacy: Possible legacy Windwatcher, unverified. Use the address, then check it and acknowledge the legacy warning.
localDiscovery.incompatible: This Windwatcher server does not advertise the API or authentication this client supports.

profiles.title: Saved servers
profiles.label: Local display label
profiles.labelHint: Optional; 1–80 characters, without controls. Leave blank to use the address.
profiles.existing: This address is already saved as {{label}}. Update its label and inspection snapshot deliberately.
profiles.saved: Server saved locally. No account was created or signed in.
profiles.confirm: Forget this local server profile? This does not change the remote server.
profiles.confirmAccounts_one: Forget this profile and remove its {{count}} local account and credentials? Remote accounts are not deleted.
profiles.confirmAccounts_other: Forget this profile and remove its {{count}} local accounts and credentials? Remote accounts are not deleted.
profiles.supported: Last advertisement: v1/password supported; not a current connectivity or identity check.

errors.unavailable: Storage is unavailable. Check system storage or the credential service, then retry; restarting may be required.
errors.locked: Unlock the system credential vault and retry. Metadata is retained for cleanup; some credentials may already have been removed.
errors.corrupt: Invalid data or damaged storage. Labels must have 1–80 characters without controls. Existing storage was not reset; preserve it for recovery.
errors.write-failed: Storage could not confirm the write. Reload saved state before retrying.
errors.permission-denied: Storage access was denied. Check browser or system permissions and retry.
errors.version-unsupported: Storage uses an unsupported version. Use a compatible client; data was not reset.
errors.conflict: Saved state changed elsewhere. Reload before making further changes.
errors.quota: Storage is full. Free space and retry; the change was not saved.
errors.too-large: The credential record exceeds this system's secure storage capacity. It was not saved; use a compatible client or contact support.
errors.duplicate: This address or account already exists. Reload and explicitly update the existing record.

discovery.title: Add server
discovery.intro: Inspect a self-hosted Windwatcher server without signing in. Save it only after reviewing the result.
discovery.hint: Enter an HTTP or HTTPS server root, optionally with a proxy prefix.
discovery.invalidUrl: Enter a valid HTTP(S) server root without credentials, /v1, query or fragment.
discovery.httpWarning: HTTP is not encrypted; traffic may be observed or altered.
discovery.rateLimit: The server rate limit was reached. Try again later.
discovery.access: The discovery endpoint denied access. Check the address or server policy.
discovery.serverError: The server returned an error. Check the address and try again.
discovery.timeout: The request timed out. Check connectivity and retry.
discovery.redirect: The endpoint redirects. Enter its canonical address directly.
discovery.network: The request failed. Check connectivity, certificates and server settings. Browser CORS or mixed-content rules may also block it.
discovery.invalidResponse: The endpoint returned invalid or incompatible metadata.
discovery.supported: This endpoint advertises Windwatcher v1 and password authentication. This is not identity verification.
discovery.open: Self-registration is advertised as open. Existing accounts may also sign in.
discovery.closed: Self-registration is closed. Existing or administrator-provisioned accounts may sign in.
discovery.signInAfterSave: Save this server first, then sign in from Saved servers.
discovery.wrongService: This endpoint advertises a different service.
discovery.unsupportedApi: This server does not advertise the supported v1 API.
discovery.unsupportedAuth: This server does not advertise password authentication.
discovery.legacyRecognized: Discovery metadata is absent. An unauthenticated response suggests a legacy v1 API, but does not verify identity.
discovery.legacyUnknown: Discovery metadata is absent. Compatibility with Windwatcher cannot be confirmed.
discovery.acknowledge: I understand this server is unverified.
discovery.legacySummary: Login and registration may be available, but compatibility and registration policy are unknown. Inspection alone saves nothing and creates no account.

urlError.scheme: Include http:// or https:// and a host.
urlError.queryFragment: Remove the query and fragment from the address.
urlError.apiRoot: Enter the server root, without the final /v1.
urlError.invalid: Enter a valid server root without spaces, controls or traversal.

discovery.probeFailed: Discovery metadata is absent; the additional compatibility check failed. Compatibility remains unconfirmed.

foundation.temporary: Language and appearance apply only until you close or reload the app.
foundation.showcaseHint: Local examples only. No server is contacted and nothing is saved.
foundation.serverHint: Include https:// and an optional reverse-proxy path.
foundation.serverError: Example validation: enter a complete server address, including the protocol and host name.
foundation.info: Information: presentation choices are available without an account.
foundation.warning: Warning: these examples do not establish a server connection.
foundation.error: Error example: the server address is incomplete. Review the field and try again.
foundation.success: Success: the example input was reset locally.
